slug: 2026-02-16 Libya's GIA presents Government Data Governance vision at cloud-computing workshop

facts.fact: The document states the General Information Authority (GIA), which runs the Open Data Platform, had recently launched indicators covering 91 datasets on it; it does not tie the platform to an open data policy, and gives the month only (workshop of 15 February 2026).

The GIA revealed the draft national policy for open government data on 27 November 2025, with a national technical guide issued, and said it would distribute both to government entities for official adoption.

The GIA, which runs the platform, launched the Open Government Data Platform at opendata.gia.gov.ly on 27 November 2025, simultaneously with the draft national open data policy, with first-phase datasets, APIs and indicators but no dataset count or named publishing bodies.

The GIA, which runs the platform at opendata.gia.gov.ly, reported statistics to February 2026 of 91 datasets, 9 active government entities participating and 8 sectors covered; the document does not tie the platform to an open data policy.
